title: Target geometric comparison equivalences
statement:
Under the derived localization instances and geometric hypotheses in the following signature, the explicit residue cycle quotient has an additive equivalence to degree-one structure-sheaf fibre cohomology: theorem picard_residue_homology_geometric_comparison_targets
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{v},
      HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Y : Scheme.{v}) (U : Y.Opens), HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1}
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S) {n : ℕ}
    (Xi : Fin n → Scheme.{v}) (fi : ∀ i, Xi i ⟶ S)
    [∀ i, Flat (fi i)] [∀ i, IsProper (fi i)] [∀ i, LocallyOfFinitePresentation (fi i)]
    (ui : ∀ i, Xi i ⟶ X) (hui : ∀ i, ui i ≫ f = fi i)
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S) [IsImmersion k]
    (w : W) (s : S) (hw : k w = s)
    (τ : (Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (S.fromSpecResidueField s))).obj L ≅
      SheafOfModules.unit (pullback f (S.fromSpecResidueField s)).ringCatSheaf)
    (U : W.Opens) (hwU : w ∈ U) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (p : Ideal Γ(W, U)) [p.IsPrime]
    (hp : p = RingHom.ker (W.evaluation U w hwU).hom)
    (C : Fin n → CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (hC : ∀ i, IsStrictlyPerfect W U (C i))
    (hCi : ∀ i, Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v}
      (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj
      ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd (fi i) k)).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback (fi i) k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst (fi i) k)).obj
            ((Modules.tensorPullback (ui i)).obj L)))) ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj (C i))) :
    Nonempty (∀ i, affineResidueCycleHomology W U p (C i) ≃+
        Sheaf.H (structureSheafAb (pullback (fi i) (S.fromSpecResidueField s))) 1)

source.place: Tags 0B91, 0BF2, 01XK; parent steps 1, 2 and 4 on homology rather than cycles

proof.text: For each i construct the fibre morphism by pullback.lift, using hui for its commutativity equation.
Combine successive/composite tensor pullback isomorphisms, pullback of tau, and the unit comparison to trivialize the target fibre coefficient. Pullback preserves invertibility.
Apply the source comparison to fi(i), its pulled-back coefficient and C(i), and use choice to assemble the family.

proof_origin.place: proved by source comparison, fibre pullback.lift, tensor composition, unit preservation and invertibility
